questions.stemHtml: A 21-year-old medical student presented to the dermatology OPD with the following image on the sole and a diagnosis of warts is being made. All of the following statements are true except? {{caption_text}}

options.label: A
options.text: HPV 2 is the most common causative organism in Superficial plantar warts

options.label: B
options.text: Deep palmoplantar warts are also called Myrmecia warts

options.label: C
options.text: HPV 6 is the most common causative organism in Anogenital warts
